pagedata.pyDescription: This activity provides a basic interface to the SendEmailNotification activity. Note that it assumes a default email account has been set up.
pagedata.pyUsage: Used by the SendEmail shape in the standard flow stencil. Note that this activity is meant mainly for demo purposes. Production systems should be using our standard correspondence (activity Work-.CorrNew)
pagedata.pyLabel: Sends email without using a correspondence record
